implementation.name: original-v4-02-motor-torque-speed-envelope
implementation.scope: The source motor voltage/duty envelope plus its illustrative installed first-order thermal model. The threefold-current burst stays below peak torque. Cold and hot curves are alternative initial histories, not successive bursts; model horizons are not certified operating permission.
implementation.question: Why is available torque limited by both speed and heat history?

purpose: Change the requested torque/speed and animate retained winding heat under two source initial histories, exposing coupled voltage and thermal constraints.
storyboard: Return to a feasible speed and begin cold
Store heat during the cold burst
guard: Current request outside the voltage envelope is not delivered torque. The burst is three times rated current, below peak torque. Installed thermal parameters are illustrative; insulation crossing is not a safety certification. Reset histories explicitly instead of cooling backward.
